title: Sieve of Eratosthenes
description: Write a Zig program that uses the Sieve of Eratosthenes to find all prime numbers up to 50.
hints: The array repeat operator `[_]bool{true} ** (n)` creates an array of n `true` values
Start marking from `i * i` for optimization
Only need to check up to sqrt(limit): `while (i * i <= limit)`
